description: In every model \(M\models Q\), \(m_M\cdot n_M=(mn)_M\) for all external natural numbers \(m,n\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.numeral_mul.{u} (M : Type u)
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.Q]
  (m n : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue M (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M m)
      (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M n) =
    Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M (m * n)
